description:
The in-memory storage backend parses each event line strictly and fails on a retired event tag, while the JSON backend skips such records. Both backends load a log through one parser, and one cross-backend test owns the property.

## Background

`domain::parse_known_events` (`crates/jit/src/domain/event_log.rs:42-76`) deserializes a record only when its type is in `EventTag::ALL` (`:66`) and skips other well-formed records. The JSON backend reads through it (`storage/json.rs:160,1352`), and so do `repository_state/mutation.rs:684` and `repository_state/archive.rs:465`.

`InMemoryStorage::load_events` (`storage/memory.rs:480-492`) deserializes each line straight into `Event` with `serde_json::from_str`, so a log holding a retired tag fails to load in that backend. The two backends diverge on one interface (`@/inv/shared-test-contracts`).

The property is owned by a JSON-only test, `test_read_events_skips_structurally_valid_retired_tags_but_keeps_strict_records` (`storage/json.rs:1830`). No `IssueStore` conformance suite for event reads exists. The shared suites that run both backends are the cross-backend conformance matrix in `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs:660`, which covers capture and publication semantics, and the redo interruption matrix in `storage/redo_conformance.rs`. Each backend seeds itself through its `test_fixtures` module (`storage/memory.rs:1330`, `storage/redo_apply.rs`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `InMemoryStorage` loads its event log through `parse_known_events`, and no strict per-line event deserialization remains in storage.
- [hard] REQ-02: One cross-backend test, run against both the JSON and in-memory backends, proves that a log holding a structurally valid retired tag loads, skipping that record and keeping every known record in order, and that a malformed known record is an error.
- [hard] REQ-03: The JSON-only retired-tag test no longer exists; its assertions live in the cross-backend test.

## Notes

The cross-backend test joins the existing cross-backend conformance matrix in `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs`, which already seeds both backends.
title: Parse in-memory event logs through the shared event parser
